final_prompt: Create a clean engineering-manual technical infographic of NASA's Perseverance Mars rover in a front-left three-quarter view. Preserve the six-wheel rocker-bogie rover layout, central chassis, mast/camera head rising from the rover body, and front robotic arm with an instrument turret. Include legible callout labels for Mastcam-Z and SuperCam on the mast/camera head, MEDA environmental sensors, MOXIE as an internal/body-mounted technology payload, PIXL and SHERLOC on the arm/turret region, RIMFAX at the lower/rear underside antenna region, robotic arm, wheels, mast, and chassis. Use precise technical-illustration composition with clear leader lines, no invented parts, and enough spacing for evidence review.
negative_prompt: Do not depict Curiosity, Opportunity, Spirit, a generic Mars rover, a lunar rover, a fictional rover, or a crewed rover. Do not add tank tracks, solar panels, cockpit glass, human seats, animal-like legs, duplicate/conflicting instrument labels, labels pointing to empty space, invented instruments, or a NASA logo unless a later policy explicitly allows it.
approval_instruction: If any required label target is missing or ambiguous, the candidate must be marked needs_review rather than approved.
